description: Assess model routing health over a time window: safeguard fallback rate, prompt cache hit rate, batch utilization, and premium spend leakage. Returns banded status per metric (HEALTHY / WARNING / CRITICAL / INSUFFICIENT_DATA / UNVERIFIED) plus overall status. CRITICAL overall status opens a Mandatory gate and halts premium-tier routing until a human approves with rationale. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

window_start.description: ISO 8601 window start. Default: 24h before window_end.

name: evaluate_routing_threshold
